gloss: foot of a mountain, mountain base

definitions.gloss: foot of a mountain, base of a mountain, foothills
definitions.explanation: The lower slopes or base area of a mountain. A somewhat literary or formal term often used in geographical descriptions, travel writing, and nature contexts.

examples.japanese: {山麓|さんろく}にホテルがある。
examples.english: There is a hotel at the foot of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {富士|ふじ}{山|さん}の{山麓|さんろく}には{牧場|ぼくじょう}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Pastures spread out at the foot of Mount Fuji.

examples.japanese: {山麓|さんろく}の{温泉|おんせん}{宿|やど}に{泊|と}まって、{登山|とざん}の{疲|つか}れを{癒|いや}した。
examples.english: I stayed at a hot spring inn at the base of the mountain and recovered from the fatigue of climbing.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary or formal word. In everyday speech, {山|やま}のふもと (foot of the mountain) is more common. {山麓|さんろく} appears frequently in written descriptions of geography, tourism, and nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山麓|さんろく}の{町|まち}: town at the foot of a mountain
- {山麓|さんろく}に{広|ひろ}がる: spread out at the mountain base
- {富士|ふじ}{山麓|さんろく}: foothills of Mount Fuji
